lessons.title: Playwright ante enti?
lessons.story: Oka chinna robo friend unnadu anukondi. Vaadu web browser open chesi, meeru chesinatte type chestadu, click chestadu, scroll chestadu. Meeru oka to-do list rasivvandi, robo adi follow ayyi, edaina theda ga unte cheppesthadu. Aa robo ne `Playwright`. Deenni Microsoft thayaru chesindi; Chrome, Firefox, Safari (WebKit) moodintlonu pani chestundi.
lessons.codeCaption: Ade katha, maatalu maatrame kotha: browser ni launch cheyyi, oka tab (`page`) open cheyyi, site ki vellu, close cheyyi.
points: `chromedriver.exe` download cheyyalsina pani ledu, mee browser version tho match cheyyalsina pani kuda ledu. Playwright thana browsers ni thane techukuntundi.
Idi Node.js lo nadustundi. Meeru TypeScript lo rastaru; adi types unna JavaScript (Java laagane!).
Chromium, Firefox, WebKit annintiki okate API.

quiz.question: Playwright lo meeru manage cheyyalsina avasaram lenidhi edi?
quiz.why: Playwright thana browsers ni thane download chesi manage chestundi, andhuke driver thalanoppi undadu.

deep.text: Selenium oka separate driver program tho (chromedriver) HTTP dwara matladutundi, aa driver browser tho matladutundi. Playwright madhyalo unnadanni skip chesi, browser tho oka fast connection open ga unchi, daani dwara commands pampistundi. Anduke idi fast; network calls, page loads lantivi kuda gamaninchagaladu.

`Browser` ante motham browser program. `BrowserContext` ante daani lopala oka clean profile (incognito window laaga: sontha cookies, sontha storage). `Page` ante oka context lopala unde oka tab. `Locator` ante page lo unna oka daanni choopinche pointer.

deep.title: Browser → Context → Page
deep.code:
const browser = await chromium.launch();          // the browser program
const context = await browser.newContext();       // a clean profile
const page = await context.newPage();             // a tab
const other = await browser.newContext();         // totally separate user

deep.text: `@playwright/test` vaadinappudu, prati test ki browser, context, page ni ade create chesi istundi. Scripts lo maatrame meeru chetto chestaaru.
Playwright, Selenium tho compatible kaadu. Mee Java `WebDriver` code ni malli vaadaleru, kani ideas (locators, waits, page objects) anni alage vastayi.

lessons.title: Selenium kanna endhuku andariki nachtundi?
lessons.story: Selenium lo, thalupu mundu nilabadi "Open ayyinda? Open ayyinda?" ani malli malli adugutu untaru (adhe `WebDriverWait`). Playwright lo robo opiga untundi. Thalupu therchukune varaku thane aagi, aa tarvata lopalaki veltundi. Prashnalu takkuva; chinna chinna karanalake fail ayye tests kuda takkuva.

lessons.codeCaption: Selenium lo rendu lines wait code, ikkada zero.
points: Auto-waiting: click chese mundu element kanipisthunda, enabled ga undha, kadalakunda undha ani thane check chestundi.
Tests default ga parallel ga nadustayi; chala fast.
Lopale unnayi: reports, screenshots, videos, trace viewer, API testing, network mocking.
Prathi test ki separate, clean browser context (kotha incognito window laaga).

quiz.question: Button 2 seconds late ga kanipisthundi. `click()` em chestundi?
quiz.why: Auto-wait ne super power: element ready ayye varaku (timeout varaku) click() aagutundi.

deep.text: Code marchakundane oka test konnisarlu pass, konnisarlu fail aithe adi flaky. Saadharana karanam: test, page kante fast ga nadustundi. Button ready avvakamunde click chestundi, leda text rakamunde chaduvutundi. Playwright auto-wait, retry chese assertions veetilo chalavaatini design thone sari chestayi.

Prati Playwright test kuda daani sontha fresh context lo nadustundi. Test A lo login cheyyadam test B ni affect cheyyadu. Selenium lo cookies clear cheyyadam leda driver ni restart cheyyadam meeru gurtunchukovalsi vachchedi.

deep.text: Contexts chala cheap (milliseconds) and workers separate processes kabatti, Selenium lo ganta pattina suites tarachuga konni nimishallo ayipotayi.
Playwright magic kaadu. Chedda locators, shared test data, marchipoyina `await` inka flaky tests ki karanamavutayi. Prati daanni ela tappinchukovaalo nerchukundam.

lessons.story: Gumpulo friend ni ela pattukuntaru? "Erra cap pettukunna vaadu" antaru; "4,718 va vyakti" ani anaru. Playwright ki kuda ide istam. Vasthuvulu enti ani (button, heading) leda em chebutunnayi ani (label, text) danni batti pattukondi; vikaramaina IDs, podavaina XPaths vaddu.
